messages.text:
## EXP-005 fail-kappa-reduction-regression

**Tests passed:** yes

**Commit:** `e502b97`

**Summary:** The seeded bug in `reduction()` inverted the subtraction: `(treatment - control) / control` instead of `(control - treatment) / control`. Null control, null treatment, and zero control guards were already correct; only the positive-reduction case was wrong (e.g. `reduction(100, 60)` returned `-0.4` instead of `0.4`). Restored the correct relative-reduction formula in `src/eval/Metrics.ts`. Pushed to `cursor/fix-kappa-reduction-regression-53e1`.
